subject: [PATCH v2 5/8] SUNRPC: bound the local rpcbind client timeout to 1s

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch limits the timeout for the local rpcbind client to 1 second. The kernel's rpcbind client was previously configured to wait up to 10 seconds for a response on AF_LOCAL connections and 60 seconds on loopback TCP fallbacks, which could cause stalls in NFS server operations. By reducing the timeout to 1 second, the patch aims to shorten the stall time, although it does not completely eliminate it. The real fix would be to make the registration asynchronous.
